acquisition_method.evidence: The analysis was performed on a Thermo Ultimate 3000 liquid nano-chromatograph coupled to a Thermo Orbitrap Exploris 240 mass spectrometer, working in DDA mode.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: After reduction with DTT (10 mM) and alkylation of Cys groups with iodoacetamide (50 mM), modified porcine trypsin (Promega) was added at a final ratio of 1:20 (trypsin-protein).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Samples were reduced and alkylated with TCEP and CAA for 30 min at 60 °C, and a total of 100 µg of protein for each sample was digested in S-Trap columns.

collision_energy.evidence: HCD fragmentation was performed using a 33 normalized collision energy.
The top 20 most intense ions from each MS1 scan were selected and fragmented by Higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) of 30%.

fragmentation_method.evidence: The top 20 most intense ions from each MS1 scan were selected and fragmented by Higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) of 30%.
The DiS cycle consisted of 255 sequential HCD MS/MS fragmentation events with 2.5 m/z-windows from 390 to 900 m/z, and with 4 m/z-windows from 900 to 1000 m/z.

instrument.evidence: Resulting tryptic peptides were loaded and washed on Evotips and separated in an Endurance 15 cm × 150 µm ID, 1.9 µm beads-EV1106 column using an Evosep one HPLC system coupled to an Orbitrap Eclipse Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher, San José, CA, USA) and a 30 SPD preprogrammed gradient.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: liquid nano-chromatography coupled to mass spectrometry

labeling.evidence: For the whole-cell proteomic analysis, label-free quantitative proteomics was performed.
